ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the core product team at a SaaS company building AI systems for complex workflows in regulated and enterprise domains. You will develop production LLM services and full-stack features, with a focus on reliability, safety, and practical user impact.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agentic systems that automate multi-step workflows across areas such as healthcare, legal, fintech, logistics, and compliance.

 - Own production RAG pipelines and retrieval infrastructure, including vector databases, embeddings, and indexing.

 - Implement multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, and reasoning components.

 - Develop evaluations, automated tests, and safety and monitoring systems to track performance and reliability.

 - Ship full-stack AI products by designing APIs and data models, building frontend and backend features, and operating services with CI/CD, monitoring, and testing.

 - Work with product and design partners to prioritize work, define success metrics, and improve features using user feedback and telemetry.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to eight years of software engineering experience delivering user-facing or backend products.

 - Production experience deploying LLMs or LLM-based services, including prompt design, orchestration, and tool integration.

 - Proficiency in Python and TypeScript, React, or equivalent, plus experience with AWS or GCP and relational or NoSQL databases.

 - Working knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines, with experience owning production retrieval infrastructure.

 - Experience building agentic systems for multi-step workflows, along with automated AI evaluations, testing, and monitoring.

 - Familiarity with agent or workflow frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI, and orchestration tools such as Temporal or Trigger.

 - Experience with enterprise-ready or multi-tenant systems, high-throughput APIs, or real-time features; regulated-industry experience is relevant.

 - Familiarity with fine-tuning, parameter-efficient tuning, or multimodal model integration is useful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $150,000 to $180,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site or remote. San Francisco, California, United States, with remote work available in the United States.
